failure_type: late detection (short sensing range) + environmental interference
explanation: The UAV collided with an obstacle at 4.0 seconds due to a combination of environmental factors and limited sensing. The 4.1 m/s crosswind, 0.49 m sensor noise, and a short 10.3 m sensing range prevented the planner from maintaining clearance, as confirmed by counterfactuals showing failure prevention when these variables were removed or improved.
